answer: Peer-audit bond: identities lock 40 credits in a vault. Each epoch a beacon pairs three auditors to recheck one work log across a bridge ledger. A marble seal must match the author's key; a copied seal or hollow history burns the bond, half to auditors. Rented auditors approving fakes lose their bonds. 1,000 fakes risk 40,000 credits plus 3,000 histories for a 40,000 pool, while an honest agent pays one 40-credit bond and keeps its full share.
